name: My green (Oct 19 scan)
axes: x = right, z = toward where the scan started (screen down); heights along gravity up
originNote: origin is the corner of cell [row 0, col 0]; cell centers at origin + (i+0.5)*cellSize
notes: Tilt kept (not detrended). Median per 10 cm cell, points >8 cm off the local 40 cm surface dropped, small gaps filled, 1.5-cell Gaussian smoothing. lowConfidence = cells where the scan shows two overlapping surfaces (tracking drift).
